# Epistle of Barnabas Chapter 17 — Disagreement Log

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Agents:** EMET / LOGOS / PNEUMA

---

## Disagreement 1 — v.1: "teaching and doctrine" vs. "a different kind of instruction"
- EMET: "another teaching and doctrine"
- LOGOS: "another teaching and doctrine"
- PNEUMA: "another teaching — a different kind of instruction"
- **Ruling:** "another teaching and doctrine" — *heteran didachēn kai gnōsin* — the hendiadys "teaching and doctrine" preserves the doubling of the Greek; PNEUMA's rephrasing loses the pair.

## Disagreement 2 — v.2: "shining angels" vs. "light-bearing angels"
- EMET: "shining angels of God"
- LOGOS: "light-bearing angels of God"
- PNEUMA: "radiant angels"
- **Ruling:** "light-bearing angels of God" — *angeloi tou theou lamphroi* — *lamphroi* = shining/bright; "light-bearing" connects the Way of Light to its angelic guardians more explicitly; LOGOS is preferred.

## Disagreement 3 — v.2: "set" vs. "stationed"
- EMET: "set shining angels of God"
- LOGOS: "stationed the light-bearing angels"
- PNEUMA: "stationed his radiant angels"
- **Ruling:** "stationed" — *tetagmenoi eisin* = have been appointed/stationed; "stationed" has the military assignment sense appropriate to the cosmic governance language.

## Disagreement 4 — v.3: "Ruler of this present time of iniquity" vs. "ruler of this present time of lawlessness"
- EMET: "Ruler of this present time of iniquity"
- LOGOS: "ruler of this present time of lawlessness"
- PNEUMA: "lord of the way of darkness is the ruler of this present lawless age"
- **Ruling:** "ruler of this present time of lawlessness" — *archōn tou nyn aiōnos tēs anomias* — "lawlessness" (*anomia*) is the standard term; "iniquity" (EMET) is acceptable but more archaic; LOGOS is cleaner.

**Total disagreements: 4**
